app.name: Revera AI
app.context: An iOS voice recorder and transcription app with live transcription, searchable transcript history, transcript summaries, keywords, action items, transcript-based AI conversations, speaker identification, and optional translation.
app.target_audience: People recording meetings and interviews, personal notes and ideas, language-learning material, or content-creation thoughts; these are the use cases offered in onboarding.
notes: User requests a fancy, creative, feature-led App Store campaign with a strong hook and especially compelling first three screens; flying objects are acceptable if they reinforce the feature.
The four original feature references are low-resolution legacy captures (250-264 px wide); the Ask or Act capture is superseded by the newer full-resolution Ask AI reference.
Keep the phone supportive rather than dominant, give feature-led copy and breakouts the hierarchy, use 9:41 in every status bar, and keep a consistent toolbar/chrome treatment.
Mention speaker identification as a concise feature callout without fabricating a speaker-identification screenshot.

User asked to continue with the approved ink-and-white visual direction, use supplied screenshots as feature references, and use realistic randomized demo data where helpful. Capture each device screenshot fresh through RocketSim; keep iPad captures device-specific.

benefits.headline: CATCH EVERY THOUGHT LIVE
benefits.reasoning: Leads with the core live-transcription benefit and gives the first frame an urgent, memorable hook.

benefits.headline: TURN RECORDINGS INTO ACTION
benefits.reasoning: Shows the outcome of summaries, extracted keywords, and action items; include speaker identification as a small supporting feature callout.

benefits.headline: ASK YOUR TRANSCRIPT ANYTHING
benefits.reasoning: Makes transcript-grounded AI assistance the third high-impact benefit and pairs with the new Ask AI screen.

benefits.headline: FIND ANY MOMENT FAST
benefits.reasoning: Expresses the practical value of searching a populated transcript library.

benefits.headline: TRANSLATE AS YOU LISTEN
benefits.reasoning: Highlights the optional live translation control shown on the recording screen.

screenshot_analysis.screen: Record screen with transcript segments and a translation-language control
strengths: Shows actual transcript content rather than an empty state.
Makes the translation option visible on the recording screen.
problems: Only 255 x 547 pixels, so it is not a crisp final phone-screen source.
The device edges/content are clipped and the transcript text is too small for marketing use.
screenshot_analysis.notes: Use as a reference for live transcription and translation; replace with a clean current capture for final artwork.

screenshot_analysis.screen: Record screen showing the Realtime Live state
strengths: Communicates that transcription appears while recording.
The record/pause controls make the primary action recognizable.
problems: Only 262 x 580 pixels and visibly clipped at the device edges.
The large empty transcript area weakens the feature story.
screenshot_analysis.notes: Reference only; final capture should show several readable live transcript lines and a tidy status area.

screenshot_analysis.screen: Transcript detail with summary, keywords, action items, and playable segments
strengths: Strong feature pairing for turning a recording into useful takeaways.
Shows several real product actions in one screen.
problems: Only 250 x 556 pixels; labels and content are too small to enlarge cleanly.
The lower screen is clipped and the grayscale layout has little visual hierarchy.
screenshot_analysis.notes: Use a fresh detail capture with a concise summary, a few keywords, three action items, and a visible playback row; enlarge the takeaway cards in the marketing composition.

screenshot_analysis.screen: Legacy Ask or Act prompt/result sheet
strengths: Demonstrates the idea of transforming transcript context into an answer or useful action.
problems: This is the old Ask or Act interface; the current checkout uses an Ask AI conversation screen.
Only 264 x 576 pixels, clipped, and not representative of the current interaction.
screenshot_analysis.notes: Replace for final pairing with the current Ask AI conversation: one transcript-specific user question, a concise response, and the Copy/Share actions visible, in light mode with a clean status bar.

screenshot_analysis.screen: Populated transcript library with search and recordings in multiple languages
strengths: Shows transcript search and a useful populated history.
The multilingual titles reinforce varied recording use cases.
problems: Only 263 x 574 pixels and the device is clipped at the bottom.
Several rows are truncated, making the content look crowded.
screenshot_analysis.notes: Reference only; a final capture should have a clean status bar, readable populated rows, and the search field visible.

screenshot_analysis.screen: Current Ask AI empty conversation with transcript-specific prompt suggestions
strengths: Full 1290 x 2796 source showing the current Ask AI header, Done control, suggestion cards, and composer.
The prompt suggestions clearly communicate what users can do with a transcript.
problems: Status time is 2:13 rather than the requested shared 9:41.
Conversation is at the empty/suggestion state rather than showing a sample answer.
screenshot_analysis.notes: Use as the screen-3 source and preserve its current Ask AI layout; normalize status time to 9:41 and keep the same toolbar treatment across the campaign.

screenshot_analysis.screen: Fresh iPhone 17 Pro RocketSim capture of Revera’s Record tab, idle and ready for real-time transcription, with Realtime selected and a 9:41 status bar.
strengths: Authentic current app UI captured through RocketSim.
Realtime mode, microphone action, translation control, and all three tabs are visible.
problems: The idle screen has no transcript content, so the campaign artwork must carry the live-transcription story without inventing an in-app transcript.
screenshot_analysis.notes: Used only as the small product screen in the first GPT Image concept; the waveform and headline carry the feature story.

pairings.headline: CATCH EVERY THOUGHT LIVE
pairings.reasoning: Fresh 9:41 RocketSim capture of Revera’s Realtime-ready Record screen; the headline and sculpted sound wave carry the live-capture benefit.

pairings.headline: TURN RECORDINGS INTO ACTION
pairings.reasoning: Shows summary, keywords, and action items; include a small textual speaker-identification callout without claiming it is visible in this capture.

pairings.headline: ASK YOUR TRANSCRIPT ANYTHING
pairings.reasoning: Latest full-resolution Ask AI design; use its suggestion cards and consistent header as the screen reference, with status time standardized to 9:41.

pairings.headline: FIND ANY MOMENT FAST
pairings.reasoning: Populated transcript library has the search field and varied recordings needed to support fast retrieval.

pairings.headline: TRANSLATE AS YOU LISTEN
pairings.reasoning: Recording screen shows the translation-language control alongside transcript content.

brand_color.name: Ink Black
brand_color.reasoning: Matches Revera’s matte-black app surface and black-and-white app icon; reserve a restrained live-green accent for the realtime signal.

items.feedback: User approved the visual direction by asking to continue and supplied additional feature references.
